Header-only Boost.PFR 1.92, copied from the installed `/usr/include/boost/pfr`
and `boost/pfr.hpp` on 2026-10-14. Copyright notices remain in each file;
the Boost Software License 1.0 is included here. Upstream:
https://github.com/boostorg/pfr

Private dependency of the native source authority codec. Public aggregate
fields are encoded by name and value; private state owners use explicit
visitors. No system Boost installation or Boost binary library is required.
